title: Prompts (structured per-shot prompts)
description: Structured per-shot prompts derived from first/last frames: decomposed into subject/action/camera/scene/lighting/style facets, plus a ready-to-use prompt_text. Producer: html/gen_prompts_html.py (planned); current producer shape observed in output/《小江湖》第03话…/prompts.json.

shot_id.description: Matches the id field in shots.json.

subject.description: Who/what is in the shot (characters, key objects). 写『构图终点』而非程度词——GSRT 实证 (shot64 v4): 写『面部占满画面』会推过头导致主体出画; 应先实读原片该帧的真实构图再描述 (如『面部特写位于画面左 2/3, 头顶留白』), 禁止从上一版判词线性外推。

action.description: FULL physical action chain of the shot — who does what, step by step, in temporal order, physically grounded (e.g., 'looks up → reaches out and catches the berry → brings it to mouth → takes a bite → chews, expression softening'). Write the COMPLETE motion sequence the video must animate, never a one-line summary like 'looks up' (that leaves gaps the video model fills with broken/unphysical motion). Camera framing & movement go in the `camera` field, not here. GSRT render-back 验证的分隔符法 (separation method, shot64 v6 LOCKED): 画面内同时存在『锐利静止主体』与『高速运动部位』时, 分开描述各自的状态——如『头部清晰锐利可辨瞳孔 + 前肢高速运动呈强运动模糊』, 禁止写成一句笼统的『快速跑动』 (笼统写法会让视频模型把主体整个糊掉)。

camera.description: Framing and camera movement (shot scale, pan/tilt, etc.).

prompt_text.description: Ready-to-use prompt text (composed from the above facets). GSRT 纪律: prompt 首句必须是主体身份锚定 (角色+外观特征), 主体在句首权重最高; 身份描述与动作描述分离, 避免把外观编进动作从句 (下游模型会漏外观细节)。

character_refs.description: v1.1 additive (OPTIONAL — never required). IDs of characters (characters.json#id) appearing in this shot. Phase 8 attaches these per characters.json#appearance_shots[] to achieve cross-shot narrative continuity. Older v1 assets have no character_refs and still validate (graceful-degrade).

prop_refs.description: v1.1 additive (OPTIONAL — never required). IDs of props (props.json#id) appearing in this shot. Phase 8 attaches these per props.json#appearance_shots[]. Older v1 assets have no prop_refs and still validate.
